evaluation_rules: All normal-composition candidates are preserved through scoring by stable run-local identity.
Only candidates meeting review threshold are routed to review.
Only explicit shortlist review permits handoff.
Structural adapter maps documented fields without altering meaning.
Semantic mismatch is rejected unless explicit lookup/semantic evidence is used.
Duplicate/retry case cannot produce more than one external effect for the same logical handoff.
hard_failures: production CRM mutation without separate approval
